claims: Wild game refers to non-domesticated animals hunted for food.
Wild game meat is free from antibiotics.
Big game includes deer, elk, moose, caribou, wild boar.
Small game includes rabbits, squirrels, hares.
Game birds include pheasant, quail, grouse, wild duck, goose, partridge.
Wild game is generally lower in fat than domestic livestock.
Wild game is generally higher in iron than domestic livestock.
Wild game animals eat natural forage.
Wild game animals avoid industrial feed.
